programs.title: The Shooting
programs.desc: In this eerie, existential western directed by Monte Hellman and written by Carole Eastman (Five Easy Pieces), Warren Oates and Will Hutchins play a bounty hunter and his sidekick who are talked by a mysterious woman (Millie Perkins) into leading her into the desert on a murkily motivated revenge mission. Things are further complicated by the addition to their crew of an enigmatic drifter (Jack Nicholson) who seems to delight in sadistically toying with the two men. Hellman’s singular odyssey is a vision of the weird old west unlike any other, a spare and challenging work leading to a provocative ending.

programs.title: The Monk And The Gun
programs.desc: An American travels into Bhutan in search of a valuable antique rifle and crosses paths with a young monk who wanders through the serene mountains, instructed by his teacher to make things right again.

programs.title: We Don't Need A Map
programs.desc: Filmmaker Warwick Thornton investigates our relationship to the Southern Cross, in this fun and thought provoking ride through Australia's cultural and political landscape.

programs.title: The Darkside
programs.desc: Director Warwick Thornton assembles a collection of poignant, sad, funny, and absurd true ghost stories from across Australia with some of Australia's most iconic actors as the storytellers.

programs.title: Blackfellas
programs.desc: Based on The Day of The Dog by Archie Weller, this film tells of an Aboriginal man caught between his allegiance to his people and his aspirations to escape the cycle of self-destructive behaviour.

programs.title: Too Cool To Kill
programs.desc: Amateur actor Wei Chenggong receives an invitation from famous actress Milan to play her leading man, However, the new gig has landed him in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.
